summary.text: Melissa Wiklund is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota Senate for District 51, first elected in 2012 and re-elected in 2016, 2020 and 2022.
Her official Senate page lists committee assignments including Health and Human Services, Commerce and Consumer Protection, Finance, and Human Services, and shows her in her fourth term.

sources.title: Senator Melissa Wiklund (51, DFL) - Minnesota Senate
